searchText: In which channel is the convo for the call data gas reduction happening? The EIP isn’t live yet, but I guess we could use <#745077610685661265> or <#688075293562503241> PS: really enjoying the current all core devs convo Unrealistic but would be awesome if there were summaries of convos and dumbed down explanations 😂 That’s what I try to do in my tweets and blog posts <@636289909359116290> 😅 If there’s any topic you think I should cover LMK I know the eth long term road map is merge then sharding but I think that’s too simplistic given the current discussions. How you see rollups L2’s sharding etc affect tps, block size, and gas price every year for the next 5 years would be pretty awesome Like are there target gas prices each year and tps and how the eth network is going to evolve would be really interesting. I’ve seen some very high level charts that are impossible for the average person to digest What a lot of people want to see is how eth plans to pass solana in 5 years. Which I think is already in the minds of most eth devs but isn’t in the minds of the common person. Most people don’t understand that eth is still very undeveloped compared to how much is planned Also would be nice to see some explanation on how rollups may come to dominate block space and implications of 4444. Also I’m really curious how much gas rollups/L2’s are burning. Networks like polygon need to have a set annual issuance they exchange to eth? I think this one can be helped if Vitalik provided an update to his previous roadmap 😀 rollups and other L2s get you unbounded throughput Like that's it it's just an engineering and ux problem the major roadblock I see is ecosystem fragmentation, which could be addressed if someone makes a good wallet that supports multiple rollups transparently with a decent rollup-aware payment address spec No EIP or magicians post yet, so reddit or here as long as it fits the <#745072678079168654> message And a question I have is how much overall impact will it have on shrinking current block use people are discussing it in <#745077610685661265> i have a recent update on the roadmap here you might be interested in. high level, personal perspective. doesn't cover everything https://trent.mirror.xyz/82eyq_NXZzzqFmCNXiKJgSdayf6omCW7BgDQIneyPoA Thanks, I understood 70%, very good summary. Definitely so much more to write, especially about rollups, l2's etc. I'm also curious how they will fit into sharding, will they each pick out a specific shard or be balanced over all of them, questions questions.
